title: Jonah and the Atlas
author: Marguerite Sterling
blurb: Tamsin Vane, a pearl diver's child indentured to a trading company, keeps a low profile and busy hands. Then the army requisitions the town and the ledger with all the names — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must get the truth on the record ahead of the victors' historians, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
